message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep for the Products.txt list, covering the 24-hour window ending 2026-07-06 05:10 IST (2026-07-05 23:40 UTC). No confirmed new vulnerabilities were found that both appeared within this window and clearly matched the monitored products.

**Findings**

No relevant new vulnerabilities were retained for this run. Fresh public advisory searches included GitHub Advisory Database entries published on July 5, 2026, CISA KEV/current bulletin sources, vendor/security pages for browser, operating system, network, database, web server, and monitoring products, and targeted MongoDB-adjacent searches. Items that appeared fresh but did not match the product scope were excluded, including Apache Camel component advisories, cve-search issues involving MongoDB collections, and generic or low-confidence CVE aggregator entries. Older items for monitored products, such as Notepad++ CVE-2026-3008, Chrome/Firefox June updates, Ubuntu July 2 notices, and Fortinet advisories with older publication dates, were treated as outside this 24-hour window or not clearly fresh.

**Possible Matches Needing Review**

None.

Closing note: No immediate review is recommended from this run based on the evidence available. Continue normal monitoring, especially for vendor advisories that may lag public CVE aggregator entries.

Sources checked include: GitHub Advisory Database (https://github.com/advisories?query=published%3A%3E2026-07-04+published%3A%3C2026-07-06), GitHub Advisory Database targeted monitored-product query (https://github.com/advisories?query=published%3A%3E2026-07-04+published%3A%3C2026-07-06+WordPress+OR+OpenSSL+OR+Node.js+OR+Python+OR+Erlang+OR+Git+OR+Redis+OR+Elasticsearch+OR+MongoDB+OR+PostgreSQL+OR+MySQL), Fortinet PSIRT (https://fortiguard.fortinet.com/psirt), Mozilla Security Advisories (https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/), Chrome Releases 2026 archive (https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/), Ubuntu Security Notices (https://ubuntu.com/security/notices), Wordfence Vulnerability Database (https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities), Cisco Security Advisories (https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/publicationListing.x), and CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog (https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog).
